GST Reforms Seminar Held in Kanpur to Enhance Tax Compliance

01 Nov 2026, 11:48 PM IST · GlobeWire Daily World Desk · Source: www.inextlive.com

2 min read

Overview of the GST Outreach Program

A seminar titled 'Sahaj Kar Samvad: Saral Anupalan, Sashakt Kar-data' was organized at the Merchants Chamber Hall in Civil Lines, Kanpur. The event was facilitated by the Office of the Commissioner of CGST and Central Excise, Kanpur, to educate local business stakeholders on recent modifications to the Goods and Services Tax framework.

Key Participants and Topics Covered

The session focused on the recommendations and decisions originating from the 57th GST Council meeting. The event saw attendance from approximately 110 participants, including:

  • Local traders and manufacturers
  • MSME representatives
  • Exporters
  • Chartered Accountants and tax practitioners
  • Legal advocates

During the proceedings, CGST Commissioner Manoj Kumar presided over the session, while Assistant Commissioners CN Mishra and Prakash Veer Singh Meena, alongside CA Dharmendra Srivastava, provided detailed briefings on the council's recommendations. A core component of the seminar was an interactive segment where officials addressed specific queries and concerns raised by tax professionals and business owners regarding the implementation of the new rules.

Objective of the Reforms

Commissioner Manoj Kumar stated that the ongoing refinements to the GST structure are intended to simplify tax administration and foster greater trust between the government and taxpayers. He encouraged business owners and tax advisors to stay updated with the latest regulatory changes to ensure operational compliance and benefit from the streamlined processes.

How to Verify GST Updates

For those seeking official confirmation of the discussed changes, taxpayers are advised to check the official portal of the Goods and Services Tax Council of India. Official notifications and circulars regarding the 57th Council meeting recommendations are typically available on the government's tax department website (gst.gov.in).
